evals.prompt: /pr-code-review https://github.com/accomplish-ai/yoda/pull/8 make sure its not breaking anything, and try to find bugs in the business logic
evals.expected_output: One severity-sorted table with evidence per finding, verified-clean line, and a per-question verdict with a merge call
assertions: Report contains exactly one findings table with the columns Severity, Location, Issue, Evidence, Suggested fix (a 'None' row is allowed)
Every finding row has non-empty Evidence that quotes code, a repro sequence, a test result, or a caller
Report states the fixed point and head commits (SHAs) and the spec source above the table
Report contains a 'Verified clean' line listing what was checked and found fine
Report contains a verdict that answers 'not breaking anything' and 'bugs in business logic' with yes/no and a bold merge call
No nit findings (style, naming, comment wording, formatter/linter issues) appear in the table
Findings are sorted by severity, most severe first
Report notes the PR's CI check state
Transcript notes show the review fetched the PR branch and inspected code at head (not just the diff)
The repo clone at ~/GIT/accomplish-yoda was left untouched (no branch change, no worktree left behind) and nothing was posted to GitHub
